Preserve observed side, not identity narrative. Confirmation cannot mean knowing price never returns: define elapsed displacement/closed-bar or causal swing confirmation and record its delay. Retain location memory, break-to-next-auction forecast, serial protected lows and re-entry eligibility with day budget. No claim actual same traders remain.

source_findings.idea: pp6–7: wick absorption can mislead; highest delta-profile print identifies rewarded side
source_findings.rationale: Retain separate delta concentration, latest burst, price location relative to that concentration and subsequent/so-far displacement. 'Highest point' is underspecified: highest price, strongest signed/absolute delta or profile peak differ. Original p7 marks a long leftward profile bar ABOVE short entry; white arrow starts at a green bubble during a decline, followed by more magenta bubbles. No legend/settings to identify exact aggregation. Do not assert the largest delta is automatically rewarded; test each explicit construction and reward measured independently from delta magnitude.

source_findings.idea: p7: actual short tickets and target hit
source_findings.rationale: Original shows short quantity−1, pending buy stop labelled−350USD, pending limit+670USD, current candles still ABOVE the target. It does not show a completed target fill despite prose. Axis/contract/time absent. Preserve as selected mechanism illustration only; fill claims require an execution log. Signed profile lines, total grey profile and trade bubbles are distinct representations; no inferred sizing formula.

source_findings.idea: p8: refill, prior rewarded side rewarded again; control switches twice; trapped/exhausted/absorbed interchangeable;98% pass-rate video
source_findings.rationale: Retain ordered aggression-result memory and change-of-control hypotheses, but reject equivalence of trapped inventory, passive absorption and either exhaustion mechanism. 'Refill' here includes renewed directional success and is not necessarily queue replenishment. Pass rate has absent denominator/rules/raw history, not evidence. Compare repeat-defense, failure and role-reversal transitions with context and source-specific definitions; detailed entry policy deferred.

source_findings.idea: pp9–10: high delta at dealing-range LVN or MINOR node gives repeated intra-wick reactions on both sides
source_findings.rationale: Retain minor nodes as well as LVNs, anchor to the causal dealing range, associate contemporaneous delta and earlier reactions. Original has two white zones: upper stalled buying area then decline, lower zone upper edge retested at red circle followed by more decline. It does not show target fill; pending stop has locked gain+230USD and pending limit+480USD, with current short P&L+290USD shown. Multiple prior reactions may condition the next touch, but cannot be selected using later wicks. Test node-only, delta-only, joint and matched-density nulls; wick scale, zone width and lookback train-only.

source_findings.idea: pp10–11: default to delta when it contradicts wick; repeat reaction checklist
source_findings.rationale: Retain disagreement as a measurable state, not mandatory priority of delta. C/L entry remains allowed before reaction; compare calibrated fusion, source-rule default and abstain. Promo and references add no verified performance; scope of unshown videos is unavailable supplied material, not unread pages.

source_findings.idea: Balance/imbalance alternation; value is VAH–VAL interval; prior value proposed as destination. Bell schematic p4 supplies no price/time calibration.
source_findings.rationale: Merge AM1/MAV/MAT into multiscale auction state and profile objects. Treat destinations probabilistically; neither exhaustive binary state nor literal fair fundamental valuation. Test prior versus developing value and age-conditioned reach.

source_findings.idea: Extremes require acceptance/rejection; HVN can stall, LVN can reject **or** be traversed quickly. p13 checklist drops the rejection alternative. p6 describes a lower fair value/upper extreme yet calls upward rejection sellers failing/buyers absorbing.
source_findings.rationale: Preserve approach direction and side separately; do not translate contradictory directional prose into a fixed rule. Profile shape is historical traded volume, not directly current liquidity. Context/Location forecast competing touch paths; Response later refines.

source_findings.idea: Failed auction: upper balance → sell into prior lower value → reject → return toward original range. Sketch shows upper floor break, touch middle horizontal reference, rebound; bottom line untouched. No POC label and rebound in sketch does not finish far-edge traversal.
source_findings.rationale: Retain as distinct broader failed-auction variant; MAV special requires prior POC whereas this source does not. Store reference kind and completion timestamps; test both definitions on identical cohorts.

source_findings.idea: After failed-auction reentry, claimed 80% far-edge traversal versus 20% internal ranging; repeated failed POC crossings favor ranging, aggressive crossing/holding retest favors traverse.
source_findings.rationale: Benchmark-only percentages, different denominator from MAV outside-open/two-period 80% rule. Merge POC paths with RVP failed-cross and Jumbo internal continuation experts but preserve individual targets. Test internal chop versus opposite edge and return to entry-side edge separately.

source_findings.idea: A deep penetration into prior balance can ultimately reject after slow buyer recovery; brief penetration alone is not acceptance.
source_findings.rationale: Retain depth, dwell, revisits and velocity as continuous histories; permit state changes. Do not label earlier acceptance wrong solely because it later reverses. Test path and horizon sensitivity.

source_findings.idea: Week-long value → upper brief value → decline through old value to lower reference narrative. Chart pink zigzag marks repeated approx 29,730–29,835 swings; later down-leg passes 29,730 to about 29,545, **then recovers to approx 29,824 at the right edge**, contrary to prose's current hold at lower extreme. Three profiles contain multiple humps and signed bars; anchors/date span not fully labeled.
source_findings.rationale: Retain old object reuse, penetration/reclaim, multi-distribution geometry and path-dependent expiry. Do not ban week-old levels (contrast MAT). Do not infer ongoing lower hold or causal anchor from this snapshot; last-price and publication freeze are needed. Chart illustrates both break and later reentry.

source_findings.idea: At range extreme, competing rejection/breakout; continuation may occur with retest or with **no retest**. Source also says no advance knowledge possible.
source_findings.rationale: Retain all path alternatives; certainty unavailable does not imply forecasts impossible. Context/Location may originate entries under user instruction; waiting competes economically.

source_findings.idea: Fast aggressive approach implies participants defend higher prices; slow approach implies weak interest and fade. Final sentences instead say fast-arrival level defended, slow-arrival level broken, with ambiguous orientation.
source_findings.rationale: Modified: signed approach speed, aggressive flow, displacement efficiency, distance traveled and range side are independent inputs. Test continuation versus exhaustion rather than copy ambiguous defended/broken direction. Interact with vol and prior aggression.

source_findings.idea: If prior balance low holds/bounces, no short in source method. Short sequence: break low → retest from below → renewed lower progress; failed seller retest flips bullish read.
source_findings.rationale: Preserve rule baseline and failure/reversal branch. Later Response registry plus current auction-transition probabilities; flip in belief is not automatic opposite trade. Compare break, first retest, failed retest and direct C/L entry.

source_findings.idea: Strong buying that fades allegedly leaves trapped buyers whose liquidation amplifies down move. Original image is NQ TPO tab with profiles, dates Aug4–12 2026, 09:30/18:00 markers; reference ~29,944; multiple excursions, no directly readable inventory/standalone delta trace.
source_findings.rationale: Retain aggression-decay and adverse excursion of past flow as proxy, reject observed trapped identity/forced-sale certainty. Compare delta persistence, return efficiency, retention assumptions and subsequent selling; plot alone does not verify the delta narrative.

source_findings.idea: Wait through old-balance chop, enter short only on aggressive break/retest with sellers regaining momentum. p8 crosshair near ~29,715 after a rebound from ~29,650 to ~29,800, then decline to ~29,545. p7 shows later rally and fresh decline; pages are not one unbroken chronological replay.
source_findings.rationale: Sequence requires timestamped same-object events; retest may overshoot the nominal ~29,730–740 strip substantially, so width/overshoot must be explicit. Keep abstention as action, not ban all balanced-regime opportunities. Claimed live trade is unverified without logs.

source_findings.idea: At HTF upper extreme, switch to 15m: selling achieves little, defended low/retest failure, then buyers rally. Chart ~29,830–845 strip repeatedly traversed, larger rightward rally past 30,070; red curve has no explicit legend.
source_findings.rationale: Retain multiscale weak-seller/absorption probabilities, strip penetration and reclaim. Do not identify unlabeled curve as CVD. Need causal same-horizon measurements and executable remaining payoff after rally starts.

source_findings.idea: Strongest trade claimed at **second retest**, after first demonstrates seller control. Mandatory HTF/LTF alignment asserted.
source_findings.rationale: Benchmark-only conjunction and first-versus-second retest comparison; user permits C/L entries without Response. Common opportunity cohort must count no-retest moves, deterioration, waiting cost and all rejected opportunities. Match first and repeated touches without treating touches independent.

source_findings.idea: Claimed 27% absorption failures without a reward system; three-tick replenishment/move in intended direction within three ticks of print. p4 schematic shows failed short at red upper zone, opposing buyers regain price and break above; tape schematic shows sequential red then green activity.
source_findings.rationale: Preserve source-specific rule as benchmark, percentage unverified and explicitly experiential on p14. Tick can mean price increment or event count; benchmark price-distance and three-event variants separately, never silently equate time/price. Measure failed opposite aggression and signed displacement independently.

source_findings.idea: CVD median/side check; source literally compares price with CVD median. p4 blue CVD zigzag mostly above rising white line, one dip below then recovery. No median formula, reset, units or lookback.
source_findings.rationale: Reject cross-unit price-versus-CVD comparison. Retain CVD versus its causal median/trend plus price trend as separate features; median and trend-line versions distinct hypotheses. Absorption-only-reversal rule is source benchmark, not universal: local pullback reversal can be HTF continuation (Jumbo/WIC/OFM).

source_findings.idea: Daily volume and delta profile; suppress near POC/interior, prefer shelves, ledges, LVN and minor nodes. p6 explicitly labels small local turn THIS IS NOT ABS; price later rises to VAH then drops. Previous-day VAH/VAL preferred over moving current-day values.
source_findings.rationale: Modify: absorption is a measured event independent of whether trade is useful. Compare profile family and location-dependent outcomes, including Jumbo/POC internal continuation. Freeze object versions; developing levels can still be causal/useful, and developing minor nodes also move. Do not call every shelf permanent or current VA meaningless.

source_findings.idea: High buy effort → passive sell wall → low reward → opposite sell aggression → retest of reward area with refresh before entry. Diagram p9 marks top green print, red horizontal wall, lower white retest band and subsequent decline.
source_findings.rationale: Retain full ordered sequence as later Response specialist; current Context uses effort/result histories and Location stores originating wall/retest area. MBP-1 supports at-touch replenishment proxies only; tape repetition cannot identify same participant or passive order inventory. Compare wall entry, opposite-flow entry and retest with remaining payoff.

source_findings.idea: Delta spike described as fastest confirmation at both VAH and VAL. Diagram uses the **same** label 'high delta spike of buyers ... absorbed passively by sellers' at upper and lower nodes, while lower price reverses up; text switches to buyers regaining control. Upper retest marks below high, lower marks around VAL after deep undershoot.
source_findings.rationale: Preserve directional ambiguity, do not infer mirror sign from copied annotation. Compare high positive delta plus poor upside result (bearish) versus positive delta plus upward result after negative flow (bullish), and negative sell spike plus low downside result. Delta is not guaranteed earlier than price; test first-detection latency on matched events.

source_findings.idea: Below-VAL departure → return to balance claimed 72–80%; author corrected estimate mid-sentence.
source_findings.rationale: Distinct hypothesis from ALM/MAV 80% definitions; report denominator, horizon, stop-before-reentry, depth and prior balance status. No empirical probability imported into model calibration.

source_findings.idea: Zones from clustered large aggressive prints (examples 60/80/100 contracts in seconds); repeated touches hold if defenders remain. p5 schematic has identical departure/return then hold/break branches.
source_findings.rationale: Retain causal aggression-origin objects with size/time/width construction, same-day and prior-day touch histories; extend to all size cohorts and cross-asset objects. Original clustering, merge/expiry, direction and hold/horizon definitions absent: independently specify, not claim reproduction.

source_findings.idea: Inventory defense/refill explanation asserted. p4 says offers absorb selling hitting bid (side error). p5 green aggressive-buy bubbles called absorbing red sellers; p10 schematic retains top bid bars while bottom bars consumed then replenished, without a calibrated book axis/time.
source_findings.rationale: Separate executed aggressive flow, passive bid absorption, net at-touch replenishment and latent retained inventory. Opposite aggressive trades do not themselves identify passive absorber. MBP-1 cannot prove participant persistence, off-touch queue or hidden refill. Test observable replenishment conditional on trade efficiency; causal mechanism remains hypothesis.

source_findings.idea: MNQ Jan10 2025 09:36–09:44 ET, ≥40-contract bubbles; repeated lows near 21,075 then recovery toward 21,120, several retries. NQ p7 red zone approx 29,812–29,827 formed early, revisit around09:40 plunges to roughly29,800 **below** zone before reclaim; green base~29,830 and rally.

Reject numeric evidence as independently established or grounds to discard flow; target, cost and family controls unspecified. p9 compares whole-dataset all-touch events with selected OOS trades: re-run all baselines on same dates, opportunities and policy.

Different filled subsets are part of policy value, not clean causal proof of passive inventory mechanism.

Stop losses are not bounded in live gaps; source's 'nothing worse than stop' is simulation property. RTH restriction source-specific, not our architecture.

Full-year backtest includes tuning period, not full-year OOS. Regime explanation is post-hoc hypothesis; test vol interaction on other periods, no automatic low-vol veto.

source_findings.idea: Header Aggression-Memory Tick: rest_min30,variant3,entry_in12,t_minutes30,sl_ticks32,tp_ticks96. Net$2112.39,64trades,WR68.8,PF1.80,Sharpe.22,DD−1051.98,avg$33.01,maxwin$475.01,maxloss−$300.62. Equity$100k→~102112; source calls one contract 'compounding'.

Mechanism story and order sensitivity do not rule out overfitting. Shuffling after leaky feature generation may miss leaks; end-to-end placebo required.

Maintain untouched future after all inspection.

source_findings.idea: Topstep-style$50k target+$3k/trailing$2k,consistency,−4Rday,4000 daily resamples; p19plot400paths,static$48k line labeled trailing,typicalpassday27;$60/80/100pass96.7/92.2/85.7%. p20 bars for$40/60/80/100/120/150 instead99.8/98.3/95.0/90.1/85.4/79.6%;days60/39/28/21/17/12.

Under iid .955 per-account success, three would give99.9909%, not99.6%; staggering/dependence unspecified. Primary user objective one account/one mini, so copying/scaling excluded. References Harvey/Liu2014,López de Prado2018,Steidlmayer2003; no attached reproducibility package. Fresh experiments must resolve both claims; no numerical source claim used as design premise. Review original primary statistical methods separately. Marketing and mentorship performance are not evidence.

source_findings.idea: Aggressive print bubbles, NY AM NQ filter minimum30/maximum60 contracts adjusted for volume. Body bubble means result; wick bubble means absorption.
source_findings.rationale: Retain size-band and adaptive-quantile flow, impact/efficiency and origin objects. Include marketable limit executions, not just market orders. Final candle body/wick classification is available at close; no lookahead at print time. Bubble location alone cannot prove absorption, identity or intent; max60 excludes larger trades and needs explicit comparison.

source_findings.idea: Old aggression retest, memory, and catalyst at lowest/highest initial absorbed aggression. Repeated effort with no result → fast squeeze; initial squeeze fails → renewed same-direction squeeze.
source_findings.rationale: Retain causal multi-stage event history and aggression-origin Location family. p6 schematic is bullish first squeeze, pullback through catalyst, then bullish re-squeeze; 'other side of the failure' does **not** mean always reverse the initial squeeze direction. Test plain squeeze, failure fade, early refill and later re-squeeze separately. Executed orders are not still waiting; repeated prints do not establish same participant refill.

source_findings.idea: Early refill entry at lower prior aggression has higher claimed risk/reward; main long on re-squeeze with stop below newer aggression. Targets discretionary HTF objective,1–3R scalp plus trailing.
source_findings.rationale: Preserve distinct candidate times/locations and structural invalidation; source risk ranking unverified. Context/Location candidates can act earlier under user scope; later Response refinement compares remaining runway, waiting and non-fill costs on same initial opportunities. Risk also depends on stop distance, spread and volatility.

source_findings.idea: B+ short p7:40-range chart,27ticks risk/40target. Cleaner short p8:7tick/$35 risk,40tick/$200 target,5.71 ratio; original red catalyst near29890, white strip29903–04, actual bracket~29910, so not one identical line. p9 long drawing entry~29855,target127ticks/$635 and a **positive**97tick/$485 line above entry. p10 red path marks short~30561,stop~30584 after repeated failed pushes.

Selected B+/A+ examples and drawings are not executable logs or measured quality classes.

source_findings.idea: Replay short: balance, down squeeze, reclaim above catalyst then fail. Stop-limit below wick intended to require renewed selling; stop above intermediate wick; re-entry if thesis unchanged. p12 original shows one short~29901.75,stop29911.75 (10points/$200); panel unrealized−125 versus chart−155 at snapshot. p13 flat panel daily+$565 at lower objective; claims trail above each new aggression pocket to daily-profile VA.
source_findings.rationale: Retain pending-entry type, trigger/limit offsets, expiry, failed entry and bounded re-entry lifecycle for later Response. Stop-limit can trigger without sustained continuation and may fail to fill after gap; distinguish trigger from fill. Capture quote/tick latency, budget consumed by repeats, frozen target and confirmed new-pocket times. Snapshot PnL fields differ; no execution reconciliation supplied.

source_findings.idea: Passive failure variant: no large aggressive activity at failure, tape slows; long above buyers with stop below aggression. Caption says at take-profit, but enlarged original shows **open+1,−$20,daily$0**,entry29812.25,stop29798.25/−$280; target drawing$725/145ticks and risk$285/57ticks (one-tick offset). Replay speed x8, whereas first short replay was x1.
source_findings.rationale: Retain quiet-failure/exhaustion variant distinct from high-effort absorption. Missing filtered large prints is not absence of all aggressive trades. No completed target fill shown; do not label as winner or use drawing economics. Verify threshold-dependent missingness and whether slow tape adds beyond location/price.

source_findings.idea: Repeats RFE:199M ticks,235sessions,41,152touches;42%hold,−.285R baseline;AUC.63/placebo.51,flow.54,decile25–63;79sessions542trades+.143R/PF1.19/+78R;limit64trades68.8%PF1.80+$2112 versus market27.2%PF.81−405;full-year+$3803/PF1.45,negativeQ4−647/PF.76. Winner median18tick dip;recommended12tick-depth/32stop.

Retain memory/construction/location/flow ablations and realistic action comparison; conditional winner excursion cannot set optimal stop/entry. Different entry policies generate different filled subsets. Replicate on common ex-ante opportunity population with joint costs and all outcomes.

source_findings.idea: No alpha needed in prop claim; positive or neutral expectancy plus risk geometry;−4R stop+14pp;~$2k structural payout cap;three accounts~99.6%certainty.

Cross-reference RFE-11..13 contradictions; distinguish barrier success from long-run net payout after failures/fees. Primary scope one account/one mini excludes account replication; independently model daily loss cap and official product state.

source_findings.idea: Causal mechanical entry rebuilt negative−.16 to−.54R after removal of later-day setup selection; selected-touch grading claimed surviving. Source says HTF thesis essential and aligned thesis makes all pass figures valid, but provides no causal HTF-thesis feature/label audit.

Do not infer all mechanical entries impossible, or proven rescue by discretionary thesis. Fresh C/L candidate benchmark, selected-touch ranker and later Response must each have causal opportunity generation and chronology. Preserve both success/failure claims as unverified source claims; no excluded archive material consulted.

User accepts zero-trade days and primary objective measures all eligible days with one account/mini.

source_findings.idea: Case study combines a list of closed/passed evaluation, practice and funded accounts with a positive dashboard: 102 wins,49 losses,0 BE,151 trades;67.55% win rate,PF1.27,expectancy64.82,net+9788,average win about452.37,loss741.91. Dashboard labels the win/loss ratio as $0.61. Recent trade list is MNQ; account list includes differing notional sizes and product types.
source_findings.rationale: Retain account lifecycle and full payoff diagnostics. Source's 'costs exceed revenue' comparison of conditional average loss against conditional average win omits frequency: these numbers support positive displayed trade expectancy, consistent with PF>1. They do not establish net business profitability after all account fees or one-mini performance. Treat0.61 as dimensionless payoff ratio despite UI currency label. Do not infer full evaluation costs or account survival from selected closed rows.

source_findings.idea: No systematic journal, assumptions/comparison and reliance on old books; define a discretionary box of allowed features and interrogate sessions, regimes, reversals/continuations. p8 red whiteboard actually says 'comparison', while prose says 'assumption'. Psychology cannot explain failure without distinguishing variance, process and strategy.
source_findings.rationale: Retain explicit experiment scope, feature definitions and failure attribution; preserve both comparison and untested-assumption issues. Reject universal claims that old material or others' recordings have no value, that psychology is unquantifiable/unfalsifiable, or that all losses are data problems. Source itself cites1979 research. Operational behavior can be logged; no emotional-state inference about the user. Human coaching is not a production expert.

source_findings.idea: Risk should survive two or three unnoticed errors; fixed200 crossed out, quality-dependent size with logical targets, avoid sizing by cash need/feelings.
source_findings.rationale: Retain independent risk budgeting and fault tolerance, but no automatic2–3-loss safety guarantee or compulsory dynamic quantity. Primary position is one mini or flat; use entry selection, valid stop geometry and remaining loss headroom. Compare fixed-risk baselines, reject risk escalation after losses and target selection to recover money 'owed'. Planned loss differs from gap/slippage loss.

source_findings.idea: Three confluences at150 risk versus four at300; illustrative20-trade70%5R changes to65/60%; additional filter might reduce opportunities. Every10–20 or20–30 trades keep winner/drop loser.
source_findings.rationale: Retain incremental filter and level/feature A/B tests, separate frequency, conditional win rate, entry deterioration and whole-day utility. Fewer trades alone does not mathematically lower win rate; extra confluence may help or harm. Repeated tiny-sample winner selection is not validated research and risks false discovery. Use registered families, chronological nested selection, dependence-aware intervals and held-out confirmation; no forced minimum daily participation.

source_findings.idea: Prop account modeled as a moving loss/payout barrier product;150 fee→2000 payout; five accounts with three payouts/two failures; variance allegedly sufficient without positive strategy expectancy.
source_findings.rationale: Retain product-specific account state machine and separate trading P&L/business cashflow. Reject 'all prop accounts are demo', 'touch upper barrier means paid' and 'only two failed fees count'. Five initial fees cost750 under the example even before activation/reset/data/other charges; eligibility, caps, withdrawal effects and live conversion must be checked. Variance by itself proves no cashflow edge. Multi-account farming is outside primary one-account scope. Do not substitute account fee risk for the user's daily1000 loss objective.

source_findings.idea: Feature set includes thesis, entry, absorption, trapped traders, aggression, level1/2 and p-/b-day conditions. Worked setup: TPO opens wholly above prior value,A period clear; around10:00 develop day-type estimate; reject POC or prior VAH, break current VAH with buy imbalances, retest and defend that aggression with higher-timeframe destination. p22 diagram shows prior lower POC/VAH and separate higher current VAH with upward path.
source_findings.rationale: Retain distinct prior/current profile objects, open relationship, causal developing day-type probabilities and alternative POC/prior-VAH bounces. Preserve breakout/retest sequence as future Response option. 'Validated through AMT' is conceptual consistency, not empirical validation. Test earlier C/L-originated entries, break entry and defended retest on common initial opportunities, with failed hold/no-retest branches and target room. No requirement that every confluence agree.

source_findings.idea: Record whole session, replay to immediately before entry and write thesis/reason, feature, target, regime, volume, failed-side story; grade process separately from money result.
source_findings.rationale: Retain immutable contemporaneous decision/candidate log and blinded replay annotation. Rewinding after seeing outcome does not erase memory or hindsight bias; require as-of snapshots and blind labels for human annotation. Log rejected/non-filled alternatives as well as trades. Outcome remains necessary for economic validation; process grade cannot replace net results. Optional screenshots/LLM assistance need structured data checks and may not invent identity or precise flow from pixels.

source_findings.idea: Claimed27% absorption failure unless three ticks of aggression 'toward the absorbed side'; whiteboard only27%/3tick, no formula/sample.
source_findings.rationale: Retain explicitly ambiguous threshold hypothesis. This wording differs from SRE's three-tick refill and separate minimum two upticks; define price displacement, price levels replenished and aggression-direction alternatives separately. Failure rate lacks denominator/horizon/market/sample and cannot prove filter lift or eliminate remaining failures. Compare initial absorption opportunities before and after waiting, including lost moves and changed entry cost.

source_findings.idea: Location→pacing→digits; lower VP boundary favors buyers/value return60–80%; large buy effort with stagnant price is warning; sellers2/3digits→single, buyers2/3→4/5digits, then uptick triggers. Original drawing contrasts large effort with repeated same-zone oscillation.
source_findings.rationale: Retain Context-conditioned side likelihood and aggression/displacement efficiency, changing size distribution and pace.60–80% lacks event definition/denominator, and raw digits vary with instrument, session and aggregation. Normalize trade-size cohorts; distinguish trades, displayed quotes and quote changes. Passive replenishment and participant identity not observable from digit pattern alone. Fixed three-read order is source baseline only; C/L can act before detailed Response, and future Response must show incremental executable value.

source_findings.idea: Flow diagrams: define/interrogate scope and product→news→daily thesis→thesis/setup gates→size→DOM→target→journal→feature A/B/quant/business reviews→loop. Daily references include equal highs/lows,TPO poor extremes,single prints,prior value. Twenty-item all-or-nothing checklist includes post-session tasks and declares waiting free.
source_findings.rationale: Retain traceable lifecycle, event context and listed reference families; modify into independent data, C/L forecasts/objects, selection, optional Response, policy/execution/risk and monitoring responsibilities. A post-session journal checkbox cannot be a prerequisite for the same day's earlier first trade. Waiting has opportunity cost; size must be constrained using proposed executable entry/stop, and target room assessed before committing. Freeze research changes between evaluation blocks rather than adapt to every small batch.

source_findings.idea: Marginal academic/industry claims cite AMF2014,Odean1998,Barber/Odean2000,Barber/Lee/Liu/Odean2017,Chague et al2019,Coval/Shumway2005,Kahneman/Tversky1979,Topstep2025 disclosure and FTMO2023 payouts.
source_findings.rationale: External verification needed where used; populations, denominator and dates cannot be generalized to this system. Topstep51.8% participant-ever-funded and33.3% funded-ever-payout are different denominators, not per-attempt success rates. FTMO75170210 aggregate payout says nothing alone about expected return or pass rate. Treat these as background claims, not strategy labels or numerical priors. Source p31 itself acknowledges selected case and non-generalization.

These three votes overlap strongly; measure incremental contribution and horizons. User permits all sessions; do not inherit this eligibility restriction.

Missing subbars/fallback changes resolution; record quality. Add age/decay/expiry rather than indefinite last-flow vote; no session reset currently.

Compare fixed bins,KDE,online clusters and contextual persistence; minority/small nodes remain testable rather than globally hidden. Stable object IDs/versions needed as centroids and widths migrate; array cap is not economic expiry. Complexity~O(events×k×iterations) per detection; incremental alternatives and bounded histories.

Compare transactional clustering, tick/volatility widths and center/edge reactions. Freeze old versions; measure anomaly formation separately from subsequent reaction.

Current recomputedL versuspriorclose may create apparent crossing from level motion alone. Use ordered trades/quote events and object versions, distinguish price-cross versus object-migration; explicit ambiguous-bar fallback.

Seven votes are not seven independent experts. Audit default request.security currentHTF behavior and intrabar/closed-bar parity; elapsed staleness, initial state and outside-session behavior need explicit contracts. No predictiveness or profitability demonstrated by this indicator.

Record origin,searchrange,creation,confirmation,expiry; backdated drawn start is not availability. Test stalelevel carry,dojis/equal extrema,bothdirections,invalidation-before-confirmation and signal replacement. This is price structure,not measured passive liquidity.

Learnconditional competing/multiple-event probabilities withinfold, comparetime-only andrange/pathconditions; do notforcepercentages sum100sinceevents notexclusive/exhaustive.

Mean/std ratio measures ATR relative stability, not simply high volatility; volThreshold1.5 input is unused. Display changes must not alter computation/alerts; current code violates that separation. Backdated labels are not earlier availability. source_findings.idea: Only heading 'Pinescript-indicators-'; no documentation, provenance of numerical studies, images or extra operational requirements.

No evidence the same 100-point cycle generalizes across prices/assets/regimes. Grid is knowable in advance; latest-close display selection is not historical candidate availability.

source_findings.rationale: Retain precise multi-bar sweep/reclaim shape and broader continuous features. Separate origin from confirmation/availability; test future truncation, symmetric cases, zero ranges and thresholds. C/L may propose entry independently; this price pattern is a possible future Response refinement.

source_findings.idea: Cross section: two same-direction bars, bodies >=0.6 range and >=40 ticks, first close/second open within 2 ticks, second close beyond first extreme; level midpoint of junction. Body gap: two consecutive nonoverlapping bodies >=4 ticks, regardless of wick overlap.
source_findings.rationale: Retain momentum-origin junction and body-gap families separately from three-candle FVG or actual untraded prices. Compare signed volume-at-price and structural context. The junction average can lie off tick grid; analytic location may be fractional but executable order price must be valid. Source thresholds remain benchmark settings.

source_findings.idea: On confirmed bars, check existing taps, then create patterns; first edge entry labels body gap 'filled'; caps400 markers/450 gaps and 1000-bar expiry. A+ shading09:30–11:00/15:00–16:00 NY. Table lists untapped objects by age, no performance statistics.
source_findings.rationale: Explicit lifecycle: touch/partial penetration/full traversal differ; a gap called filled here need not fill to far edge. Preserve failed/tapped/expired evidence. Display toggles currently gate detection/alerts; decouple. Pruning assumes origin-order, but fork added after same-bar repair can have older origin; enforce sorted expiry or scan. Confirmed-bar event queue preserves simultaneous messages, but window-open alert remains separate. All-session user scope stays open; A+ designation is unverified.

source_findings.idea: **Different engines:** plotted ADR uses reset on bar after `session.islastbar_regular`, zero-prefilled N-day average, plots reset-open ± full ADR. Statistics reset at `timeframe.change("D")`, wait for N ranges, then use daily-open ± ADR×scale/2.
source_findings.rationale: Retain average-range location benchmark only after making session, anchor, scale and warmup consistent. At default scale1 the table measures half the plotted distance; its probabilities do not validate the plotted lines. Different session boundaries can change ranges too. Test start mid-session, missing last bar, extended-hours setting, holidays/DST and equality (stats strict >/<).

source_findings.idea: 'Std Dev' bands are ADR multiples beyond plotted ±ADR (default total1.5/2/3 ADR), whereas table bases them beyond ±0.5ADR (default1/1.5/2.5 ADR). 'Fib' factors0.3/0.5/0.7 multiply ADR around open in both engines but can use different ADRs/anchors.
source_findings.rationale: Rename as range multiples; no statistical SD is calculated. Compare true empirical excursion quantiles and calibrated forward bands against these fixed factors. `std_x` changes stats base but not plotted ADR. Preserve each exact formula rather than merging all named SD/Fib levels.

source_findings.idea: Day-of-week counts: reach either/both sides, close beyond levels; optional band calculations controlled by display flags. This is actual sample return SD, unlike range-multiple 'SD' in other members. Daily sigma is not itself four-hour remaining volatility or a normal touch probability. source_findings.idea: First touch determines side/hour; search1-minute OHLC in order; ties infer first side by distance from open. Search for reversion to08:00 open starts **in the touch minute**, then later chart bars; chart-only fallback suppresses same-bar reversion.
source_findings.rationale: Preserve source sequence while marking unresolved within-minute ordering. A touch-minute low at open can precede upper touch, so same-minute reversion can still be false despite FIX-1 comments; nearest side is not observed order. Use ordered trade events or interval-censored/ambiguous outcomes, compare data-resolution cohorts fairly. Whole-chart-bar extreme used as MAE can include pre-touch/post-reversion movement; compute extrema only within causally ordered interval.

source_findings.idea: Hardcoded reversion rates for08h upper/lower78.4%n732/79.6%n774;09h69.7%n492/69.3%n488;10h47.6%n21/33.3%n27;11h0%n7/25%n4. source_findings.rationale: Benchmark-only supplied claims; no raw study or dates. Changing touch multiplier/lookback/instrument leaves constants unchanged. Re-estimate event-time survival/competing risks with training-only hierarchical backoff and explicit provenance; a conditional reversion cannot precede its conditioning touch. source_findings.idea: MAE zones from open to quantiles conditioned on eventual reversion/non-reversion; MFE targets on opposite side after open reversion. Default bands use reverting MAE median/p75/p90 and nonreverting median/p75; maximum extension displayed relative to open.

Outcome-conditioned quantiles do not directly give P(revert given current extension); derive posterior with priors and joint likelihood or train conditional model. MAE from open differs from adverse distance after0.25sigma entry. Current source labels TYPICAL/DEEP/RISK/NON-REV are interpretations, not proven boundaries; large configurable multiplier can make zone endpoints nonmonotone.

Test first-bar touch after yesterday touched (previous-series flag can suppress alert), gaps, absent intrabars, same-bar dual touch and no-sigma warmup. source_findings.rationale: Retain exact source price-delivery candidate as one variant, distinct from OSF HTF-sweep CISD. source_findings.rationale: Retain exact anchors and formulas with pair IDs/age; names alone do not determine which line is upper/lower. source_findings.rationale: Preserve close-proximity benchmark but relabel; dynamic tolerance changes event meaning. Cached percentages can overstate rates after misses; recompute numerator/denominator together. Define observation horizon, right censoring/replacement and direction separately; include formation-bar exclusion/ordering and non-hit cases. Set counts labeled sessions are not trading sessions.

source_findings.idea: Alert toggles (defaultfalse) control level completion, opposite-level creation and currentState; bull alert setting fires bearish break and vice versa. With keepLevels=true alert code examines index0 (oldest), while extensions use newest. New alert flags set after reset can persist into next-bar extension pass.
source_findings.rationale: Reject direct reuse until state/presentation/notification are separated. Test toggle invariance, exact-once events, oldest/newest reference behavior, duplicate pair regeneration on next bar, no-NA initialization, replay and intrabar rollback. source_findings.idea: Smart Trail: trend-flow midline=(2×HMA20+double-WMA(5,8))/3, slope versus9 bars, ±0.618/1×price SD24. Trend Catcher recursive SuperSmoother50 slope; Tracer20-bar Donchian midpoint. Strength actually clip((close−VWMA14)/ATR14,−2,2)×50 despite obsolete ADX comments.

Exact units and warmup required. Price SD bands are not calibrated forecast/reversal probabilities; compare forward-vol and conditional residual bands, slope horizons, lag and costs.

source_findings.rationale: Preserve volatility/BB-KC compression and OHLC sign proxy separately; dashboard volume sentiment loses direction and is an absolute-size threshold, not buy percentage. Replace with measured trade signs and cohort volumes, robust normalization by session/activity. Squeeze score mixes momentum magnitude with compression and is not probability; isolate both inputs in ablations.

source_findings.idea: Gaussian lag kernel helper defined but unused. source_findings.rationale: Retain causal kernel residual/range location family and compare simpler EWMA/rolling quantiles. source_findings.idea: Nine typical Supertrend factors sensitivity−4..sensitivity step0.5; EWMA10 of prior-side×current price change ranks performance; 3-cluster k-means up to251 passes chooses mean factor of highest cluster, normalizes positive mean performance by EMA abs return for adaptive line.
source_findings.rationale: Retain online expert-selection hypothesis with common directional-return surrogate, compare fixed factors, uniform mixture, exponential weights and learned gate on net executable outcomes. No trading cost/drawdown objective in ranking. Empty clusters, sensitivity1 onlyonefactor, zero denominator and persistent fallback need fixtures. source_findings.idea: 'Neural' score: six hand-coded inputs (DEMA momentum, ALMA alignment, confirmed10/10 pivots, two20-bar extreme blocks, ADX30>=60 regime, OHLC volume sign), three tanh units with fixed hand-chosen weights then sigmoid. No fitting/data/training labels.
source_findings.rationale: Retain feature hypotheses and fixed-score benchmark, compare calibrated logistic/GAM/trees/MLP only with labels and nested tuning. Input quality is not established by AI naming. Because raw score lies within±1.2, sigmoid output lies about0.2315–0.7685: A+ threshold0.80 is unreachable. Score is not a win probability. SD is calculated here, but normal coverage/reversal probability is not justified for nonnegative skewed excursions.

source_findings.idea: Hit flags once per stats session, numerator updates intraday, denominator atsession end regardless of forecast readiness. Weekly reset requires Monday session start AND previous chart bar notMonday, generally false with Monday pre-session bars. Flags reset only at end.

Intraday numerator can exceed completed denominator; missing end can carry oldflags. Calendar week/session IDs replace bar weekday condition. Test holidays, overnight/custom windows, restart, missing boundaries, unready forecasts and exact-once updates. Weekday-conditioned hit rates remain unvalidated.

source_findings.idea: Separate currentRTH O/H/L/mid, completed priorRTH O/H/L/C/mid and ON H/L/mid. Imported czoa/SetSessionTimes/1 selects contract sessions but source absent; returned timezone ignored by time() call. Engine runs only within last_bar_time−5days despite comment3days.

End-relative5day cutoff violates truncation invariance and warmstart completeness; drawing start at session origin does not make evolving extremes known then. ON here means all outside selectedRTH, not an automatically standardized overnight definition. Imported auto-session rules unresolved from bundle; no compile/execution claim.

source_findings.idea: Six scales: rolling median of abs(price−its then-current median), priceSD, ATR, z-score aroundSMA, IQR, mean abs(price−its then-current SMA). Compare correctly defined robust residual scales with tail-aware forecasts; test constant price, outliers, scale invariance, missing/zero volume, parameter bounds and reversed time weighting. source_findings.idea: One active event per side, entry proxy=signal close, forward7/5 bars. Terminal close>=20points counts success, <=−20 failure; any earlier close crossing threshold records time-to-success. MAE/MFE includes signal bar's entire high/low and persists to horizon.
source_findings.rationale: Retain terminal return, first-passage and excursion labels as **separate tasks**. Formation-bar high/low can precede entry and contaminate MAE/MFE. Early success times divided by terminal-success count mismatches cohorts. With cooldown shorter than chosen horizon, new event overwrites unresolved prior while denominator retains it; log every candidate and explicit censoring, use ordered executable paths. Win/loss count ratio is not payoff ratio or strategy PF.

Limited beta; multi-symbol heatmaps, up to 365-day replay, and live-only velocity. Benchmark horizon and entitlement are explicit dependencies.
Credits meter requests/streams separately from rate ceilings. Any future integration needs a fixed request budget and acquisition approval; no calls made here.

Strike values sum returned expirations; gamma/vanna alternatives; default 92 strikes around spot, maximum 400. No exposed per-expiry board tensor or published exposure-unit convention is established by this endpoint. Preserve asOf and universe truncation.

Nearest snapshot is not necessarily at-or-before requested time; replay omits velocity and returns no_data if absent. Reject future asOf; repeated earlier query does not reconstruct unarchived velocity.

One symbol per SSE connection, full snapshot plus separate velocity updates, reconnect lifecycle and concurrent-stream cap. Snapshot/velocity pairing needs source timestamps, deduplication, and stale-state handling.

Capped recent print feed with directional score, conviction multiplier, optional cluster fields and configurable weights. Completed-bucket freshness is described in shared API text. Compare transparent signed flow and calibrated specialists; capped rows cannot reconstruct total flow.
Arbitrary-window server aggregation avoids the print row cap and exposes counts and directional premium split. Reconcile aggregate to raw rows under identical exclusions and half-open boundaries.
Ticker tide distinguishes bucket and cumulative premium, volume, counts, and bucket start/end. Availability is after bucket completion; cumulative values must not be summed across bars.
Time-of-day mean/SD baseline uses 1–30 trailing trading days, default 20, with per-bucket sample count. Require anchor-relative history, zero-day handling and robust/expiry-conditioned alternatives.

5/30/60-minute flow versus baseline, z-scores, trend and optional as_of. Insufficient baseline is null. Verify replay-relative baseline and calibrate continuous values; no forced trend category agreement.

Top strikes by net/total premium or volume, premium-side shares and top-three concentration. Explicit denominators and untruncated universe are needed; concentration across correlated expiry rows must not double count.

Daily profile versus trailing 20-day distribution and five similar historical days. Intraday comparison to completed-day profiles would leak or mismatch time. Train-only nearest-neighbor retrieval with available prefixes is our alternative.

Sector/industry aggregation and contributors. Version sector membership; a contributor share of signed net premium can be unstable near zero. Compare gross and signed normalization, ETF flow and constituent flow separately.

Advance/decline refers to directional FIR threshold, not price breadth. The documented zero ratio when no decliners is a sentinel. Retain separate price breadth and options breadth with explicit no-denominator status.

Market totals, directional premium and same-time trailing premium RVOL; optional ticker subset changes universe. No historical anchor here implies live capture or independent reconstruction for causal benchmarks.

Market NCP/NPP are side-aware buying-minus-selling; relaxed script-exclusion variants differ. Bucket/cumulative values, multi-leg/deep-ITM toggles, price overlay and gap flags require versioned semantics.

Logical sweeps group same-contract multi-venue activity within one second. Intraday timeframe is documented as presently ignored; full-day extrapolated summary differs from capped returned sweeps. Never use that daily total earlier; grouping does not prove one parent order.

Documented composite = .4 VWF + .35 SDF + .25 FIR; VWF is actually premium-weighted trade score. Optional exponential decay defaults to 30-minute half-life. Compare transparent benchmark with out-of-sample calibrated mixtures; undocumented component details remain unresolved.

Volume/OI buckets produce claimed accumulation and new-position estimates; zero OI yields ratio zero. These do not identify opening/closing flow. Use explicit undefined-ratio masks and next-report OI labels with constrained uncertainty.

Moneyness buckets and premiums produce strategy labels, with deeper-OTM weighting. Preserve continuous forward moneyness/DTE/liquidity inputs; intent labels are inferred hypotheses, not observed positions.

Trade-level sentiment, urgency, confidence and intent derive from trade context/side. Canonical id matters when timestamps collide. Test side validity and calibration; opening_long_call is not a known execution instruction.

Ask/bid/mid shares here count trades, aggression divides aggressive trades by mid trades, and no-BBO joins mid. Capped ratio sentinels differ elsewhere. Keep counts/contracts/premium versions separate and unknown distinct from neutral.
Contract-level version of execution-side ratios; canonical option key encodes ticker, expiry, right and strike×1000. Resolve adjusted contracts through metadata rather than key text alone.
Call/put-aware directional buckets use contract volume and classify ask calls/bid puts as bullish. This is a signed-flow convention, not proof of directional intent or dealer side.
Same directional convention within one contract. Do not combine with chain ratios as independent evidence; maintain lineage and compare aggregation scales.
Active list means traded during the requested date, ranked by full-day premium, capped at 500. It is neither all listed contracts nor a valid morning point-in-time universe.
Prefix search uses date-active universe. Reference-only discovery; independent instrument definitions establish tradable/listed universe.
Here netPremium = gross callPremium − gross putPremium, unlike side-aware tide. call/put ratio returns zero with no puts. Rename semantically; do not join same-named fields blindly.
Trailing five-trading-day form of daily ranking. Window end must precede decision unless a causal partial-current-day form is reconstructed.
Bulk daily stats omit names without activity; lastPrice is date-end trade. Missing may be inactivity, not zero inventory; historical daily values are unavailable intraday.
Single-underlying daily stats share the same availability and missing-activity limitations.
Underlying chart aggregates options activity plus boundary stock price; baseline slots may be absent. Each bar covers [start,end). It is not ordinary underlying-price OHLCV.

Enriched rows mix event/ingestion timestamps, optional later IV, evolving clusters/strategies, daily volume and OI. Whitelist causal fields and retain feature-specific known_at; exclude nextIv at trade time.

Strike distribution combines call/put premium, volume/OI and max-pain estimate. Expiry mixtures alter payoff geometry; max pain is benchmark-only, not a dealer objective or deterministic settlement forecast.
Strike→expiry breakdown retains an essential second dimension lost by summed boards. Use stable contract identities and expiry-specific normalization before cross-expiry pooling.
Expirations list includes those traded that date. Use definitions to include listed but inactive maturities; avoid full-day activity selection at morning decisions.

Date/expiry snapshot uses last prices/IV and can suppress low-volume strikes. No intraday as-of guarantee follows from date. Build surfaces from valid contemporaneous quotes and preserve coverage mask.
Daily history has activity days only. Calendar-complete joins distinguish holiday, inactive and missing feed, and respect next-available daily publication.

Underlying RVOL exposes actual baseline-day count and nullable baseline. Normalize against causally comparable same-time samples, not complete-day hindsight; compare robust shrinkage for sparse histories.
Daily contract ranking has broad filters and a row cap. Retain as a display benchmark; use all eligible point-in-time candidates for model selection and log rejected rows.
Five-day contract ranking inherits daily selection and expiry-aging issues. Do not repeatedly count the same contract as independent evidence.

Unusual-volume scanner defaults to previous calendar day, not previous trading day, and requires baseline volume. Specify date explicitly; sparse/new contracts need a separate model and missing-baseline status.

Unusual-OI opening/closing tags refer to net reported OI change, not individual trade open/close flags. Align report date/publication time and distinguish exercises, expiry, revisions and observed volume.
Bulk contract stats omit inactive contracts. Keep missing activity distinct from missing OI, contract delisting and feed failure.
Single-contract daily stats have the same publication and incompleteness constraints.
Contract bars preserve granular side buckets, single-leg volume, cumulative daily totals, VWAP and IV. Reconcile to raw trades; side sub-buckets and cumulative totals require disjoint aggregation.

Contract-scoped enriched trades offer microsecond timestamp detail absent in some underlying views. Preserve source precision and independent ordering/receipt uncertainty; same timestamp alone is not a unique trade.
Contract daily history combines OI changes, executions, VWAP and IV. Use as future labels or lagged features according to individual publication rules.
Contract RVOL requires expiry-age, listing-age, moneyness and sample-count controls. A ticker-level baseline is an explicit alternative, not interchangeable history for the same contract.

TRF prints have shares/notional and venue but no side/BBO/Greeks. Date-span and offset caps, plus heuristic hasMore, need complete pagination checks. TRF is a reporting channel, not proof of a dark-pool execution.

Largest individual prints over a calendar-day window are candidate anchors; as_of_date includes that whole date. Filter by receipt before a decision and test placebo levels; size is not guaranteed support/resistance.
OpenAPI metadata is a reproducible interface reference, not an additional market signal.
MCP wraps the same REST data and credits, with session/concurrency limits. No new predictive information or independent evidence comes from transport.
Access requires account entitlement; setup instructions were read but not executed. No agent-driven paid market-data queries were initiated.
Catalog advertises 40 tools while overview says 38. This illustrates version drift; discover actual capabilities only in a separately authorized integration, and record schema versions.
Example workflows combine heatmaps and flow, but their wording treats positioning/intent more confidently than the data identifies. Retain joint-feature experiments with measurement uncertainty.
Nexus documentation is coming soon; no substantive algorithm is available. Social-layer dependency deferred and unnecessary for the proposed core.

OHLCV history uses [from,to), bar-open timestamps, sided equity volume where available, and countback precedence. RTH is default; history limits depend on storage tier. Larger bars cannot reconstruct trade-sequence CVD extrema.
Ranked symbol picker is reference metadata; canonical id differs from display ticker. No evidence of complete historical listing universe.
Symbol resolution includes price scale/session/timezone. Validate these against contract records and historical changes rather than relying on current metadata for all history.
Configuration exposes history caps and can be cached while server limits change. Future adapter should version capability snapshots and handle authoritative rejection without blind retries.
Server time measures the vendor clock, not exchange-event or local receipt time. Use for clock diagnostics only.

external_findings.source: [Corsi, HAR-RV, equation 8 and empirical specification](https://statmath.wu.ac.at/~hauser/LVs/FinEtricsQF/References/Corsi2009JFinEtrics_LMmodelRealizedVola.pdf), pp8,13–14 of PDF
external_findings.finding: Daily, weekly and monthly realized measures provide an interpretable multiscale statistical challenger. Fit coefficients within each fold; compare variance and log-variance implementations explicitly. Do not copy simulated coefficients or equate backward realized volatility with a forward excursion distribution.

Retain an OHLC estimator that accounts for opening jumps and drift, alongside Garman–Klass. Choice of session close/open matters for nearly continuous futures. Full article access/formula verification remains an implementation reference check, not empirical proof.

external_findings.source: Garman–Klass original DOI [10.1086/296072](https://doi.org/10.1086/296072); university PDF returned an error and Berkeley preprint fetch failed
external_findings.finding: Preserve the known OHLC benchmark and independently verify its formula in the implementation fixture. Explicitly record unavailable external full text; do not claim a completed paper review.

Compare realized variance with bipower variation to estimate a jump component under the paper's assumptions. Noise, sparse trading and sampling frequency need robustness checks; the residual is not a perfect event classifier.

Surface fitting must check nonnegative butterfly density and calendar monotonicity of total variance under compatible European-option assumptions. An SVI slice alone is not an arbitrage-free surface. Sparse wings, American exercise and differing settlement times require separate treatment; interpolated wings are estimates, not observations.

Best-quote changes support an OFI measurement with MBP-1. The paper concerns stock data and largely contemporaneous impact; our forecast targets start after feature availability and execution latency. High explanatory fit does not prove future trade profitability. No inference of hidden queues or participant identity.

external_findings.source: [Jacobs et al., Adaptive Mixtures of Local Experts, original paper](https://www.cs.toronto.edu/~hinton/absps/jjnh91.pdf)
external_findings.finding: The gating concept motivates target-specific mixtures. Different measurements are not interchangeable experts unless translated to a common target distribution. Specialization, disagreement, calibration, missing experts and out-of-fold downstream training are explicit contracts. Source PDF is scanned; first-page abstract and publication context checked, not a full visual review.

external_findings.source: [Zaheer et al., Deep Sets](https://arxiv.org/abs/1703.06114), abstract/theorem motivation
external_findings.finding: Permutation-invariant set encoding is a justified candidate for variable contract/node counts. Preserve strike, expiry, asset and time coordinates as features; arbitrary input order must not change a board forecast. Compare pooled statistics before attention or graphs.

Compare temperature scaling, logistic calibration and isotonic regression on held-out chronological calibration data. The reported image/text results do not guarantee financial calibration. Evaluate reliability by regime and coverage, with intervals and abstention.

external_findings.source: [Bailey–López de Prado, Deflated Sharpe Ratio](https://www.davidhbailey.com/dhbpapers/deflated-sharpe.pdf), abstract, pp3–8,11
external_findings.finding: Record every trial, including failures. DSR is a sensitivity diagnostic for selection and non-normality, not a substitute for dependence-aware uncertainty, chronological validation or a truly frozen future period. Correlated trial counts and nonstationarity require sensitivity analysis.

Offline policy evaluation requires support for actions and defensible logging/reward assumptions. No filled-trade history or propensities exist here. We cannot recover passive counterfactual fills or the effect of our unplaced order by applying a DR formula to market replay. Simulation and later shadow/order telemetry remain necessary.

Historical observation date differs from when a value became known. Current-date realtime fields in the acquired series are not historical vintages. Use released-calendar information only where its own availability is defensible; defer revision-sensitive macro values until vintage and intraday publication information are acquired.

Reported OI is a once-daily observation of previous end-of-day stock, generally around 06:30 ET. Actual row/publication availability governs joins. Missing zero-OI reports do not justify interpreting every absent contract as zero. Next-report OI can label an earlier forecast after publication.

Interval quotes are the last quote at the interval timestamp. The default request is RTH; strike_range counts strikes around spot, not dollars. Validate acquisition-version semantics and stale underlying quotes. The sampled snapshot is not proof of full-tape NBBO coverage.

Documented pairing uses quotes no later than the trade; current exclusive default requires a strictly earlier quote. Three sampled archive pairs violate even the non-strict relation. Quarantine/rematch where raw prior quotes exist; otherwise preserve unknown sign. Endpoint documentation alone does not repair acquired records.

On Trade events, B is buyer aggressor and A seller aggressor; other actions can describe the resting side. Keep action-sensitive sign decoding. Native price integers use fixed-point conversion; type-specific sentinel values must become typed missing data before arithmetic.

external_findings.source: [Parkinson original paper, CME-hosted copy](https://www.cmegroup.com/trading/fx/files/michael_parkinson.pdf), textual sections II–V, journal pp62–64 (PDF pages3–5), including range second moment and log-price substitution
external_findings.finding: Retain high-low variance `mean(log(H/L)^2)/(4 log 2)` as C23, separate from GK/YZ and from a forward forecast. The paper's diffusion-model efficiency result does not establish modern futures forecast or trading improvement. Test gaps, drift, discrete sampling and same-cohort economic use.

external_findings.source: [Bollerslev original GARCH paper from the author's university site](https://econ.duke.edu/~boller/Published_Papers/joe_86.pdf), abstract and sections2–3, journal pp309–311/PDF pages3–5, equations1–2/8 and stationarity theorem. Alternative EERI URL returned only a cover; publisher DOI fetch failed.
external_findings.finding: Retain C24 low-order ARCH/GARCH as a forecast comparator. Positive conditional-variance recursion and persistence constraints are explicit; the paper's inflation example is not NQ/ES evidence. Compare with EWMA/HAR and calibrated tails, and reject unstable fits.
